title: First time good, second time bad
text: First time good, second time bad. I ordered these lights and was very pleased with the outcome at first. I didn't realize the bulbs were frosted but nevertheless they emitted a nice glow. I ordered them a second time and although it was the same exact order which was placed only two weeks prior, they got the order wrong. They sent a set of clear white lights instead of the red and green. It was too late for me to send it back for an exchange (especially that they did not offer shipping with Prime) so I just went to Lowes and bought bulbs to change them out.
